text_block_list.text:
On a very particular day for auspicious
wonders,
Matikanefukukitaru gains an
abundance of good
luck.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Believing this to be the grace of the
great
Shiraoki, she begins preparing for
the Twinkle
Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
